title: Policy Decision
description: Output of the policy engine for a remediation plan. Attached to the evidence bundle to document why an action was allowed, escalated, or denied.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this policy evaluation

policy_version.description: Version or commit hash of the policy pack used

allow.description: Whether the plan is allowed to proceed (with or without approval)

require_approval.description: Whether human approval is required before execution

decision.description: Summary verdict — must match guardrails.rego output

risk_score.description: Computed risk score that informed the decision

constraints.description: Execution constraints imposed by the policy

required_evidence_fields.description: Evidence fields that must be persisted before any side-effecting tool call

approval_binds_to_plan_hash.description: Whether an approval, if required, must reference the plan hash it authorises

fallback_on_timeout.description: Path taken if the obligations cannot be met within timeout_seconds

approval.description: Present only if require_approval was true and approval was obtained. Approval binds to a specific plan hash for a bounded window: any re-planning changes the hash and invalidates the approval.

approval_method.description: Channel through which approval was obtained

plan_hash.description: Hash of the exact remediation plan this approval authorises. Must equal pre_execution.plan_hash in the evidence bundle.

valid_until.description: Expiry of the approval. Execution starting after this instant requires a new approval.
